gold: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy

selector.rationale: The presence of leukemia cutis, violaceous cutaneous lesions, and a high percentage of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid analysis strongly support the diagnosis of leukemia, which is further reinforced by the patient's symptoms and laboratory findings.

rejected.label: Cauda equina syndrome
rejected.why: While nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots are present, they are not sufficient to explain the full range of symptoms and findings, particularly the presence of leukemia cutis and atypical cells/blasts.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: Although some findings such as nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots and diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within the bone marrow could suggest neurolymphomatosis, the presence of leukemia cutis and the high percentage of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid analysis more strongly support a diagnosis of leukemia.
